# Check the serialized JSON spelling of a canonicalized floating zero, and
# whether an empty SQL array insertion at the end extends the target array.

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_ARRAY_APPEND(JSON '[]', '$', -0.0))
?>

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_ARRAY_INSERT(JSON '[]', '$[0]', -0.0))
?>

SELECT TO_JSON_STRING(JSON_ARRAY_INSERT(JSON '[]', '$[0]', ARRAY<INT64>[]))
?>
